gateways.name: Yamagata Station
gateways.notes: Yamagata Shinkansen terminus and the primary gateway to Zao Onsen. Yamako Bus to Zao Onsen Bus Terminal departs from the East Exit.

gateways.name: Zao Onsen Bus Terminal
gateways.name_ja: 蔵王温泉バスターミナル
gateways.notes: Central arrival point in the village, ~3 min walk from Zao Ropeway Sanroku Station. Tourist information and ski locker rentals on site.

gateways.name: Sendai Station
gateways.notes: Tohoku Shinkansen gateway, useful when combining Zao with the Tohoku region. Direct Sendai-Yamagata-Zao highway buses available.

gateways.name: Sendai International Airport
gateways.notes: Closest international airport. 25 min by Sendai Airport Access Line to Sendai Station, then Senzan Line to Yamagata.

gateways.name: Tokyo Haneda Airport
gateways.notes: Most domestic and regional international flights. ~30 min by Keikyu + JR to Tokyo Station for Yamagata Shinkansen.

routes.notes: Yamagata Shinkansen (mini-shinkansen, runs on conventional gauge from Fukushima). Trains often coupled with the Yamabiko to Sendai.
Direct bus from Yamagata Station East Exit. Last bus down from Zao around 21:00 in peak season; check seasonally.
Seasonal direct service from Sendai. Useful when arriving via Sendai Airport or the Tohoku Shinkansen.
Sendai Airport Access Line → Sendai, then JR Senzan Line to Yamagata (about 1 h 20 m total). Alternative to flying via Haneda.

in_resort_transport.name: Village walking circuit
in_resort_transport.notes: Zao Onsen village is compact and walkable end-to-end in ~10 minutes. The Ropeway Sanroku station, bus terminal, public baths and ryokan are all within a 500 m radius.

in_resort_transport.name: Zao Ropeway (Sanroku → Juhyo Kogen → Jizo Sancho)
in_resort_transport.notes: Doubles as in-resort transport: two stages totalling 2.6 km that move skiers from the village to the upper juhyo zone.
